article.title: The Power and Peril of Platonic Male Touch
article.description: Men’s loneliness isn’t natural—it’s learned. A forgotten history of platonic male touch reveals how cultural shifts over the last 150 years trained men to fear affection and closeness.
article.content:
Men are lonely in ways we dont quite know how to talk about.
